label: Model-based recurrent raw-log-return shared-one-block path-density Q policy - 33 exposures - 64-epoch gamma/friction curriculum

transition.representation: at one recurrent phase concatenate the conditioned 256-value market embedding, all 64x16 path embeddings, the 32 one-step probabilities, 32 learned component log-return values in bps, expectation, and entropy

architecture.network: the checkpoint-compatible cyclic density model emits and advances its full market+path recurrent state; one shared GNGLU projects state plus its one-step marginal to 256 values; one live-gradient linear head emits post-rebalance Q-bar for every exposure

rl.reward: expected exact log wealth integrated over the current learned one-second return mixture
rl.marketTransition: the density model's own shared recurrent market and path transition; no historical next feature row is used in a Bellman target
rl.portfolioTransition: exact marked-exposure drift for each return-mixture component
rl.counterfactualActions: every predicted transition supervises all 33 actions; recurrent phases 0..14 cycle across batches
rl.target: Double-Q action selection with Polyak target evaluation over the next predicted latent state; repeated one-second Bellman backups provide the long-horizon value

selection.testPolicy: sealed until the best target-schedule validation checkpoint is selected
